options.content: ⚠️ Wrong Way Events

panels.description: List of wrong way vehicle events detected in the corridor.

targets.query:
import "strings"

from(bucket: "SS-Anthem")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "wrong_way_alert")
  |> pivot(
      rowKey: ["_time"],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.wrong_way and r.wrong_way > 0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      full_vehicle_id: if exists r.object_id then r.object_id else "N/A",
      vehicle_id: if exists r.object_id and strings.strlen(v: r.object_id) >= 8 then strings.substring(v: r.object_id, start: 0, end: 8) else (if exists r.object_id then r.object_id else "N/A"),
      location: if exists r.location then r.location else "N/A",
      speed: if exists r.speed then string(v: r.speed) + " km/h" else "N/A",
      event_url: if exists r.event_url then r.event_url else "",
      frame_url: if exists r.frame_url and r.frame_url != "" then r.frame_url else ""
  }))
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "vehicle_id", "full_vehicle_id", "location", "speed", "event_url", "frame_url"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "vehicle_id", "full_vehicle_id", "location", "stall_duration", "event_url", "frame_url"])

🚦 Congestion Events

panels.description: List of congestion events detected in the corridor.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "SS-Anthem")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "congestion_events" or r["_measurement"] == "region_obj_dwell_2")
  |> pivot(
      rowKey: ["_time"],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      region: if exists r.region then r.region else "N/A",
      location: if exists r.location then r.location else "N/A",
      avg_dwell_time: if exists r.dwell_time then string(v: r.dwell_time) + " s" else (if exists r.avg_dwell_time then string(v: r.avg_dwell_time) + " s" else "N/A"),
      avg_speed: if exists r.avg_speed then string(v: r.avg_speed) + " km/h" else (if exists r.speed then string(v: r.speed) + " km/h" else "N/A"),
      frame_url: if exists r.frame_url and r.frame_url != "" then r.frame_url else "/images/vehicle-events/latest_congestion.jpg"
  }))
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "region", "location", "avg_dwell_time", "avg_speed", "frame_url"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
